coordinate_system: Full 1920x1080 pixel coordinates, x right y down; source crop origin x640 added; no scaling.
method: Same native Vision landmarks on matching Q/R frames16–34. Lip contour dimensions measured parallel/perpendicular to eye line. Comparison against configured rigid-core dy; no source modification.
limits: Native landmark detection can move slightly under subpixel resampling and video compression; tiny dimension differences are not proof of reshaping.
A vertical translation preserves local geometric relationships within the rigid core; it does not remove head pitch, scale, roll or eyelid changes.
This targeted check does not assess neck/shelf feather artifacts; separate reviewer owns them.
Parent owns audio/decode; not duplicated here.
